ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 70-75% of the surface area, with low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated at the perimeter and in internal linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central core of both lobes is contiguous high-intensity white; distal edges and the median notch region are bordered by low-intensity black; vertical linear dark streaks are present in the interior sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 65-75 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, forming a symmetrical recurved arc toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, vertical, and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting across the white high-intensity fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular serration and potential loss of tissue at the distal tip of the right lobe (viewer perspective), resulting in a jagged, multi-pointed edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ink-streak' pattern of dark pigmentation extending downward from the trailing edge into the white ventral field.
